title: MCP alerts tool for storage alerts
goal: NERV can poll FPVBuddy's open alerts the way it polls Grover's
acceptance: A read-only MCP tool lists the open storage alerts in the shape F-013-T01 names (nerv:F-122's contract), newest first; a re-poll in the same stage returns the same key and since; specs cover a raised, a repeated-daily and a cleared alert; the consumer tool table lists it
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one read-only tool over F-013-T02 on an existing server. Not a measurement.
